ideas.pitch: A multilingual local health awareness and preventive care web portal tailored for semi-urban communities in India.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Campus Health Connect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns strongly with accessibility and purpose judging criteria, matching the multilingual approach from the SAGACITY win that resonated well with local civic needs.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support and tracking platform to audit campus sustainability and energy consumption.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation AI Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear measurable impact and leverages multi-agent student support architectures proven at the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge gated community portal allowing students from various campuses to verify course completion without revealing personal identities.
ideas.title: OpenBuild ZK Credential Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves genuinely hard engineering with ZK circuits, satisfying technical depth metrics for top-tier judging panels.

ideas.pitch: An automated AI executive assistant tailored for campus club leads and hackathon organizers to manage timelines and community submissions.
ideas.title: Campus Chief of Staff Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes a live working product demonstration that addresses real pain points faced by hackathon organizers and student leads daily.

ideas.pitch: An interactive computer vision application that classifies campus recyclables via phone camera feeds to promote proper waste segregation.
ideas.title: OpenBuild Smart Campus Waste Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an immediately testable live camera demo and clear environmental impact metrics that appeal directly to hackathon judges.
